guardrails: Absence of a presence event means UNKNOWN, not slow or unhealthy.
Presence is a capacity signal, not a worker-quality score.
An active V11 execution claim overrides presence and yields ACTIVE_CLAIM.
READY and HEARTBEAT leases expire automatically; stale presence cannot authorize a generated claim.
PAUSE and OFFLINE remain explicit until a later READY event.
Manual claim overrides remain possible through existing execution override paths and must stay explicit.
